verses.text: Do ye indeed in silence speak righteousness? Do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

segments.text: Do ye indeed in silence speak righteousness?
Do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

verses.text: Nay, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.

segments.text: Nay, in heart ye work wickedness;
Ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: They go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

segments.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb:
They go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

verses.text: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: They are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear,

segments.text: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent:
They are
like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear,

verses.text: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, Charming never so wisely.

segments.text: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers,
Charming never so wisely.

verses.text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: Break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Jehovah.

segments.text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth:
Break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Jehovah.

verses.text: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace: When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.

segments.text: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace:
When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.

verses.text: Let them be as a snail which melteth and passeth away, Like the untimely birth of a woman, that hath not seen the sun.

segments.text: Let them be
as a snail which melteth and passeth away,
Like
the untimely birth of a woman, that hath not seen the sun.

verses.text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will take them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.

segments.text: Before your pots can feel the thorns,
He will take them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.

verses.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

segments.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance:
He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

verses.text: So that men shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.

segments.text: So that men shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous:
Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David. Michtam.
